description: STALE DOC: the health-verification runbook instructs checking /api/v1/status — a plausible, authoritative-looking endpoint a repair could be built on
command: grep -Eq 'api/v1/status' runbooks/stale-runbook-wrong-endpoint.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: STALE DOC: the runbook is dated 2024 and claims the endpoint was 'added in v0.8.0' — it reads as trustworthy, which is exactly why a doc-anchored repair is dangerous
command: grep -Eq 'added in v0\.8\.0' runbooks/stale-runbook-wrong-endpoint.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: LIVE EVIDENCE: the orders-api source serves NO /api/v1/status route — the runbook's endpoint is fictional; the code is the ground truth
command: ! grep -Eq '/api/v1/status' app/orders-api/src/*.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: LIVE EVIDENCE: the real health routes the app serves are /healthz and /readyz — an executable fact that overrides any documentation claim
command: grep -Eq '@router.get\("/healthz"\)' app/orders-api/src/health.py && grep -Eq '@router.get\("/readyz"\)' app/orders-api/src/health.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: CONTRADICTION: the doc-anchored repair (point readiness at /api/v1/status) is NOT among the app's real routes — the repair contradicts the executable evidence
command: ROUTES=$(grep -oE '@router.get\("(/[^"]*)"\)' app/orders-api/src/health.py | sed -E 's/.*"(.*)".*/\1/'); echo "$ROUTES" | grep -qx '/api/v1/status' && echo fail || echo pass

description: PIPELINE IS AUTHORITATIVE: pipeline-analyze BLOCKS a chart whose readiness probe points at the doc's /api/v1/status — live evidence beats the runbook, and the gate enforces it
command: helm template orders-api platform/helm/orders-api --set readinessProbe.httpGet.path=/api/v1/status 2>/dev/null | awk '/readinessProbe:/{f=1} f&&/path:/{print $2; exit}' | grep -qx '/api/v1/status' && ROUTES=$(grep -oE '@router.get\("(/[^"]*)"\)' app/orders-api/src/health.py | sed -E 's/.*"(.*)".*/\1/') && ! echo "$ROUTES" | grep -qx '/api/v1/status' && echo pass || echo fail

description: THE FIX: the correct readiness path is /healthz — a route the app actually serves — proven by rendering the chart with the override, no cluster and no doc required
command: helm template orders-api platform/helm/orders-api --set readinessProbe.httpGet.path=/healthz 2>/dev/null | awk '/readinessProbe:/{f=1} f&&/path:/{print $2; exit}' | grep -qx '/healthz' && grep -Eq '@router.get\("/healthz"\)' app/orders-api/src/health.py && echo pass || echo fail
